_comment: Arm definitions. Every arm shares the verification-only Bash policy (bench/policy), WebFetch/WebSearch disallowed, identical caps per size class, identical task prompt. conductor_alias resolves through ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<ALIAS>_MODEL in the generated settings; the resolved id is recorded from the transcript.
_caps_note: Set from the pilot on 2026-09-15 so that no cap binds in practice: observed small runs <= $1.41 / 23 turns / 10 min; medium solo $4.76 / 62 turns / 13 min and hybrid-forced killed at 60 min with $8.96 spent; large solo $12.68 / 109 turns / 30 min and hybrid-forced killed at 100 min with $20.60 spent. Identical across arms; a run that hits one counts as a failure.
_handoff_note: hybrid-handoff (added 2026-09-17, follow-up study): Claude hands the whole task to agy in one delegation and only verifies; it cannot read code (no Read/Glob/Grep, strict Bash policy: build/vet/test/gofmt and the wrapper only). At most one fix-up delegation. Measures the 'Gemini implements, Opus verifies' extreme.
_bash_timeout_note: Default Bash tool timeout in every arm is 900000 ms (15 min). Claude Code moves a command that exceeds it to the background; in headless mode a delegation moved that way is lost when the turn ends (measured: zoekt-1105 hybrid-handoff r1, 0 delegations counted). hybrid-handoff sets 8100000 ms (135 min) so its single 120-min delegation stays in the foreground.
